svg.text: HybridFlow RL post-training - Single Hybrid Controller + Multi-Process Computation Engines
L2 - Hybrid Controller (Single Process Control Flow)
Single controller - not on Ray head
Decoupled: swap FSDP/Megatron without changing control flow
Colocated actor + rollout + ref via create_colocated_worker_cls
LoRA PPO: ref = base model of actor
Flexible GPU mapping across cluster sizes
Server mode vs SPMD rollout executor
Controller RPC: split DataProto - dispatch to workers - collect and concat results
L4 - Pluggable Training & Rollout Engines (Model Engine v0.7+)
Written as single-process code - backend swappable via WorkerGroup config
Step 3: reward_wg.compute_scores - token-level reward from rule/model RM
Step 4: compute_advantages on controller - DataProto.union merge all tensors
Two-level dataflow: control flow (algorithm logic) separate from computation flow (NN train/infer)
GRPO/DAPO: same loop structure - critic optional - recipes in verl-recipe submodule
Eliminates memory redundancy and comm overhead at train/generate transition
Offload KV to CPU after gen
Production: Doubao-1.5-pro, Seed-Thinking-v1.5, DAPO SOTA - 671B DeepSeek/Qwen3-235B MoE
Observability: wandb / swanlab / mlflow / tensorboard / Grafana-Prometheus
NVIDIA + AMD ROCm + Ascend NPU - ByteDance Seed / Volcengine - EuroSys 2025 - up to 20x throughput vs naive RLHF
Init path: Ray cluster - build WorkerGroups on ResourcePool - init_model all workers - load HF/Megatron ckpt
Step path: generate - logprob/ref/values - reward - advantages - update actor/critic - HybridEngine reshard - repeat
Sources: verl-project/verl README - HybridFlow paper arXiv:2409.19256 - verl.readthedocs.io hybrid_flow - v0.7 blog
